title: Ang Checkpoint
setup: May nahuli kang driver na walang lisensya. Bumulong siya: 'Settle na lang, sir. Pang-merienda lang.' May dala siyang anak na may sakit.
setup_en: You catch a driver without a license. He whispers: 'Let's just settle it, sir. For merienda.' He carries a sick child.

success.text: By the book. Tumatagalog ang dangal mo.
success.text_en: By the book. Your honor holds.

fail.text: Nagmakaawa siya. Nasaktan ka, pero nanatili ka.
fail.text_en: He begs. It hurts, but you held.

choices.label: Tulungan kitang makuha ang lisensya.
choices.label_en: Let's help you get a license.

success.text: Tumulong ang mga kapitbahay. Maayos ang lisensya.
success.text_en: Neighbors help. The license is sorted.
